author: International Court of Justice (ICJ)
locator: Advisory Opinion of 19 July 2024 (Case 186), paras. 78–102 (single territorial unit; Oslo Accords cannot derogate from Fourth Geneva Convention per Art. 47), paras. 115–156 (settlements & forcible transfer), paras. 251–285 (unlawfulness of continued presence)
notes: Authoritative judicial opinion under Art. 65 of the ICJ Statute requested by UNGA Res. 77/247, finding that the West Bank, East Jerusalem, and Gaza form a single territorial unit, that Oslo cannot detract from Fourth Geneva Convention duties, and that Israel's continued presence in the OPT is unlawful.
rights: Official judicial record of the International Court of Justice.
title: Legal Consequences arising from the Policies and Practices of Israel in the Occupied Palestinian Territory, including East Jerusalem — Advisory Opinion of 19 July 2024
